connectorGrammar.rule: A local edge requires one distinct text-free source Shape with both geometric endpoints uniquely aligned to decoded Fiber markers. Connect rows alone do not create edges.
connectorGrammar.result: All 775 previously unreviewed connectors have two endpoints and each aligns to exactly one marker (1,550/1,550). 575 use a simple two-row MoveTo/LineTo path; 200 have more complex source geometry retained per row.
connectorGrammar.limitation: Local drawn transition evidence does not certify Closure identity, Port semantics, ownership or cross-document activation.
